front.title: AER-1 Receipts as Audit Records for WIMSE AIMS

abstract.t: The WIMSE AI Identity Management System (AIMS) framework requires deployments to produce durable audit logs covering authorization decisions and subsequent remediations, requires those audit records to be tamper-evident, lists the minimum fields an audit event records, and calls for reconstruction of complete execution chains across service boundaries. AIMS deliberately specifies no audit record format. This document supplies one candidate: it maps each AIMS audit requirement onto the AER-1 execution receipt, field by field, shows how AER-1 hash-chained timelines and workflow receipts reconstruct an execution chain, and defines an optional carriage of AER-1 receipts as SCITT statements for deployments that operate a transparency service. The mapping changes no AER-1 field, digest construction, or verification rule, and it states plainly what a receipt does not prove.
